content_sections.heading: About Amrita Administrative Assistant
content_sections.text: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham, Amritapuri Campus is seeking a qualified candidate for the Administrative Assistant – Academic Quality & Accreditation position within its school. The selected candidate will support academic administration, accreditation documentation, quality assurance activities, and departmental record maintenance by working closely with faculty coordinators, the Department Chair, IQAC, and other administrative units.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Administrative Assistant position must meet the essential qualification requirement specified by the institution. Essential Qualification: Post Graduation - MBA Additional Requirements: Highly organized, detail-oriented, with the ability to manage academic administration, quality assurance activities, and departmental record maintenance.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Administrative Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The role entails specific responsibilities associated with academic quality and administrative support at the Amritapuri Campus: Supporting academic administration, accreditation documentation, and quality assurance activities. Maintaining departmental records systematically. Working closely with faculty coordinators, the Department Chair, IQAC, and other administrative units. Maintaining documentation required for NBA, IQAC, NAAC, NIRF, academic audits, and institutional reviews.
